request.query: Roth abs_eval_lt_of_le_index polynomial Taylor index upper bound

items.name: one_le_pow_mul_abs_eval_div
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_eval
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (s : R),
  Polynomial.eval s ((Polynomial.taylor r) f) = Polynomial.eval (s + r) f

items.name: taylor_mean_remainder_bound
items.type:
∀ {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {f : ℝ → E} {a b C x : ℝ} {n : ℕ},
  a ≤ b →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑n + 1) f (Set.Icc a b) →
      x ∈ Set.Icc a b →
        (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, ‖iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.Icc a b) y‖ ≤ C) →
          ‖f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Set.Icc a b) a x‖ ≤ C * (x - a) ^ (n + 1) / ↑n.factorial

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_eval_sub
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (s : R),
  Polynomial.eval (s - r) ((Polynomial.taylor r) f) = Polynomial.eval s f

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)
